items.title: Animated Loaders
items.description: Five accessible Motion loaders (dots, bars, ring, orbit, pulse) in currentColor that fade instead of moving under reduced motion.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Drop-in shadcn/ui Menubar styled to match DuskUI menus, with sub-menus, checkbox and radio items.

items.name: animated-menubar
items.title: Animated Menubar
items.description: Desktop-app style menubar whose menus spring open and whose highlight glides between top-level triggers.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: shadcn/ui Resizable panels on react-resizable-panels v4 with a handle that highlights while dragging.

items.name: resizable-layout
items.title: Resizable Layout
items.description: IDE-style resizable layout with a sidebar panel that animates collapse and expand; keyboard resizing works.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Collapsible with smooth height animation.

items.name: motion-collapsible
items.title: Motion Collapsible
items.description: Collapsible with spring height, content fade and a rotating chevron.

items.name: show-more
items.title: Show More
items.description: Show more / show less block that springs open long text or lists behind a fading mask.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: shadcn/ui Drawer on vaul, styled for DuskUI with a drag handle.

items.name: responsive-dialog
items.title: Responsive Dialog
items.description: Dialog on desktop, drawer on mobile, chosen by a hydration-safe media query.

items.name: snap-drawer
items.title: Snap Drawer
items.description: Bottom drawer with snap points that settles at partial heights as you drag.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: shadcn/ui Chart helpers (ChartContainer, tooltip, legend) on Recharts v3, themed for DuskUI.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: Area chart with a gradient fill that draws in, styled tooltip and reduced-motion support.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: Bar chart with a hover highlight on the active bar and themed tooltip.

items.name: radial-stat
items.title: Radial Stat
items.description: Radial progress stat on Recharts with an animated value in the centre.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: shadcn-style Field primitives (Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldSet) plus Label.

items.name: animated-field-error
items.title: Animated Field Error
items.description: Field error message that animates its height in and out and shakes the field once on submit.

items.name: signup-form
items.title: Signup Form
items.description: Dependency-free validated sign-up form built from Field, Input, Checkbox and Button with animated errors.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: shadcn-style Input Group with inline and block addons, buttons and text, focused as one control.

items.name: copy-input
items.title: Copy Input
items.description: Read-only input with a copy button whose icon morphs into a check.

items.name: url-input
items.title: Url Input
items.description: URL input with an animated protocol addon and validity indicator.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: shadcn-style Button Group that joins DuskUI Buttons horizontally or vertically, with separators and text.

items.name: animated-button-group
items.title: Animated Button Group
items.description: Button group with an active indicator that glides between options.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: Primary action joined to a dropdown of secondary actions.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Stepper number input with rolling digits, press-and-hold repeat, keyboard and Intl formatting; spinbutton semantics.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: Tag input where Enter or comma adds chips that pop in, Backspace removes, duplicates shake, with optional suggestions.

items.name: hyper-text
items.title: Hyper Text
items.description: Text whose letters scramble and resolve left to right on hover, in view or on mount, without layout shift.

items.name: text-animate
items.title: Text Animate
items.description: Animate text by character, word or line with presets like blurIn, slideUp and scaleUp, on mount or in view.

items.name: flip-words
items.title: Flip Words
items.description: A word in a sentence flips in 3D to the next word on an interval while the width springs to fit.

items.name: highlighter
items.title: Highlighter
items.description: Marker highlight, underline, circle, box or strike-through that draws itself behind inline text in view.

items.name: aurora-text
items.title: Aurora Text
items.description: Selectable text filled with a slowly moving multi-colour aurora gradient.

items.name: blur-fade
items.title: Blur Fade
items.description: Entrance wrapper that fades children in from blur and offset when they enter view, with stagger support.

items.name: custom-cursor
items.title: Custom Cursor
items.description: Smooth trailing dot-and-ring cursor that grows over interactive elements and shows labels; scoped or page-wide.

items.name: scratch-to-reveal
items.title: Scratch To Reveal
items.description: Canvas scratch card that reveals its content as you scratch, with a keyboard-accessible Reveal button.

items.name: progressive-blur
items.title: Progressive Blur
items.description: Layered backdrop-blur bands that fade content into a smooth blur at any edge.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: Accessible file tree with keyboard navigation, animated expand and collapse and a gliding selection highlight.

items.name: shine-border
items.title: Shine Border
items.description: Wrapper that sweeps a soft multi-colour sheen around a thin border.

items.name: rainbow-button
items.title: Rainbow Button
items.description: DuskUI Button with an animated rainbow gradient border; default and outline variants.

items.name: pulsating-button
items.title: Pulsating Button
items.description: DuskUI Button with expanding pulse rings that pause on hover, focus and reduced motion.

items.name: interactive-hover-button
items.title: Interactive Hover Button
items.description: Pill button whose dot expands to fill it on hover while the label swaps for an arrow.

items.name: moving-border
items.title: Moving Border
items.description: A soft beam that travels around an element's rounded border, plus a ready MovingBorderButton.

items.name: retro-grid
items.title: Retro Grid
items.description: A synthwave perspective grid: a faint floor that scrolls toward the viewer and recedes to the horizon, with an optional striped sun.

items.name: flickering-grid
items.title: Flickering Grid
items.description: A canvas grid of small squares that flicker at random, optionally masked so squares only appear inside a word.

items.name: ripple
items.title: Ripple
items.description: Concentric rings that expand from the center in a staggered, seamless loop, with optional ripples spawned wherever the pointer presses.

items.name: wavy-background
items.title: Wavy Background
items.description: Layered, flowing waves drawn on a canvas from seeded noise, each in its own color and softened with a blur.

items.name: lamp
items.title: Lamp
items.description: An overhead lamp: a thin bar whose two conic light cones widen into place when the section scrolls into view, lighting the content below.

items.name: globe
items.title: Globe
items.description: Interactive WebGL globe with markers and arcs that auto-rotates and spins with spring momentum when dragged.

items.name: icon-cloud
items.title: Icon Cloud
items.description: A slowly rotating 3D sphere of icons that you can steer by hovering or spin by dragging, with nearer icons larger and brighter.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack
items.description: A stack of cards where the top one can be swiped left or right, by drag, buttons or arrow keys, while the rest spring forward.

items.name: countdown
items.title: Countdown
items.description: A countdown to a target date with rolling or flipping digits, a compact variant and throttled screen reader announcements.

items.name: vanish-input
items.title: Vanish Input
items.description: A prompt field whose placeholder cycles through suggestions and whose text dissolves into particles when submitted.

items.name: image-compare
items.title: Image Compare
items.description: A before/after comparison slider that reveals one layer over another with a clip-path as you drag the divider, hover, or use the keyboard.

items.name: sortable-list
items.title: Sortable List
items.description: A vertical drag-to-reorder list built on Motion's Reorder: drag rows by their handle, neighbours spring out of the way, and the keyboard can pick up, move and drop rows too.

items.name: kanban
items.title: Kanban
items.description: A kanban board whose cards drag between columns and reorder with layout springs, with a live drop slot, column counts and a full keyboard alternative.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A star rating input with hover preview, half steps and a pop as stars fill, exposed as a keyboard-friendly slider that also submits with forms.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A multi-step flow that manages content panels and navigation, with an animated progress line, check marks that draw on completed steps, direction-aware panel slides and optional per-step validation.
